title: Anomaly detection method and system based on federal learning and knowledge distillation
assignee: Hefei Institute Of Innovation And Development Tianjin University

pse.problem: Unbalanced original samples, high communication loss, and low level of data security and privacy protection in anomaly detection using federated learning
pse.solution_function: Anomaly detection using federated learning and knowledge distillation for balancing original samples, reducing communication loss, and improving data security and privacy protection.
pse.solution_structure: Federated Learning system composed of local encoder, local decoder, peer encoder, peer decoder, anomaly detection module, metric learning module, security aggregation module, early termination module.
pse.solution_implementation: Local encoder and local decoder are trained using federated learning with peer encoder and peer decoder based on normal graph data. Anomalous samples are generated by the federated autoencoder model constructed by the local encoder, local decoder, peer encoder, and peer decoder. Metric learning module is used for training and testing to obtain a low-dimensional representation of feature vectors. Anomaly detection module screens the low-dimensional representation that meets requirements. Security aggregation module performs security aggregation on model updates. Early termination module calculates the difference and terminates federated learning if the difference is greater than the threshold.
pse.effect: Improved balance of original samples, reduced communication loss, enhanced data security and privacy protection
